text:
Mira (CS): FYI customer reported charge failures in prod — charge-tool fncall returning 400 schema validation. attaching sample request/response.

integration-bot: [alert] charge-tool:fncall failed (invalid_args) x3 in last 10m — ticket auto-created.

Sam (Reliability): Can you paste the failing payload + response?

Mira (CS): sure — here's one of the payloads we received and the runtime validation error: 
```
Request payload (model->tool): {
  "name": "charge_tool",
  "arguments": {
    "amount": "two hundred dollars",
    "currency": "USD",
    "card_id": "card_123"
  }
}

Response (runtime): {
  "error": "schema_validation_failed",
  "details": "arguments.amount: expected number, got string 'two hundred dollars'"
}
```

Jordan (SE): That looks like instruction bleed — somewhere earlier a system/few-shot example asked the model to humanize amounts. Did the customer include any examples or a system prompt that would encourage that?

Mira (CS): Yes — customer shared their prompt snippets. they have a system example that explicitly shows humanized output: 
```
[
  { "role": "system", "content": "When responding, humanize numbers in examples, e.g. 200 -> \"two hundred dollars\"" },
  { "role": "user", "content": "Charge 200 for order #42" }
]
```
This example appears before the model is instructed to emit structured args for the payment tool. the model seems to apply the humanization to the tool arguments.

Kai (Eng): Thanks — which model + function-calling mode are they on? If they rely on free-text JSON instead of strict function-synthesis mode, that can cause types to be converted.

Mira (CS): Hosted API, model `redwood-instruct-1`, function calling enabled (we interpret model tool suggestions and validate against the tool schema). Customer did not use `response_format:json` or strict schema enforcement on their side.

Sam (Reliability): Any impact on latency or billing?

Mira (CS): Customer sees ~2% failure rate for charge requests during peak. Retries by their app caused extra tokens and some duplicate charge attempts (they caught duplicates). They flagged this as billing risk.

Jordan (SE): Quick mitigation options: 1) Advise customer to remove/relocate humanizing few-shot examples so they don't appear before tool invocation. 2) Patch our tool adapter to coerce numeric-looking strings into numbers for amount fields as a fallback (sanitizer). 3) Add a validation warning header so customers see when coercion happens.

Kai (Eng): I'll take the sanitizer task. Plan: runtime will attempt to coerce `amount` fields when schema expects number (regex detect digits/currency) and log a WARNING. Also extend tool schema to accept `number|string` for backwards compatibility, with deprecation in logs. I'll open a PR and a changelog note.

Mira (CS): I'll send the customer repro & mitigation guidance. Repro curl (they can run locally):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"When responding, humanize numbers in examples, e.g. 200 -> \"two hundred dollars\""},{"role":"user","content":"Charge 200 to card_123"}],"function_call":{"name":"charge_tool"}}'
```

Sam (Reliability): Please include logs (X-Request-ID) from one failing request so we can correlate. Also add the customer's account id and whether this happened across regions.

Mira (CS): Will do. Customer case CS-4981. They reported failures from EU region only so far. I attached request-ids in the ticket.

Kai (Eng): I'll prioritize a small runtime patch (coercion + log) and then follow up with a safer long-term change: stricter tooling for function-calling that prevents example-style transforms from affecting function args.

Jordan (SE): Also recommend a docs blurb: "Avoid humanized examples before function calls; prefer raw numeric examples if you expect numeric args." I'll draft it and send to devex.

Mira (CS): Thanks team — escalating to eng-oncall now. I'll update customer once we have a hotfix ETA. :thumbsup:

integration-bot: Linked ticket CS-4981 -> ENG-2746 (hotfix)
